dmn_experiences.title: Bristol Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: An afternoon combining a private harbour ferry trip with onboard tastings, a behind-the-scenes tour of Moor Brewery and final tastings with food at the Beer Emporium on King Street.
highlights: Private 30-minute harbour ferry with tastings of two local beer styles
Behind-the-scenes tour and tasting at Moor Brewery
Cheese and meat platters to share at the Beer Emporium

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A 90-minute cocktail-making class at The Cocktail Club Bristol, where an expert bartender teaches the techniques behind two cocktails of your choice. Includes a competitive daiquiri challenge.
highlights: Make two cocktails from a set list
Suited to birthdays, hen parties and corporate groups
